name: minio-server3
note: A machine we own, amortised flat over its disk: 15 usd a month for the 8 vcpu 24 GB vps, over 380 GiB of usable store, which is the storage_per_gb_month below and the only priced line on this card. Requests and bytes are free because the disk does not bill for them; what they cost is the box, and the box is already in that number. Fill in the real invoice amount before publishing any dollar figure from this. This is the one card not exported from tamnd/zou, because a machine has no list price and zou's self-hosted-minio card refuses to guess one; this is that card with our own --box and --box-tb folded in.
